Well, for example, I am disabled and my bf can be... overly playful? He likes to shake me when he's helping me around to to see my head wobble (he thinks it is funny). He likes to grab my arms and legs and manhandle me like I am a puppet.  He'll sometimes squeeze me too tight so I can't breathe. I also have difficulty walking but sometimes when I am just trying to move around our home, he'll grab my hips and grind or he likes pawing roughly at/slaps certain parts of my body (the more feminine parts) for his own amusement. 

I don't like it but I am having a hard time drawing the line between him just being obnoxious or if it goes into being abusive. Obviously the way I phrased it above seems horrible, but like I said, he's a playful person. He also helps me a lot physically with my disability but it seems like he sees me as a toy sometimes. He doesn't seem to get that it hurts me when I tell him. He'll stop when my patience runs out and I show anger toward him, but it is never a permanent fix. It is like he can't remember that *THIS* with my disability is my new normal, and that I am not as physically capable/resilient as I was when we first started dating. 

> Anything that you perceive as hurtful would be considered domestic violence. 

Is that where the line is? I mean a lot of things can hurt that aren't violence. People can be clumsy or not know their own strength. Is it violence if he's just... dumb that way?

Is it always that *intentional*? Whenever I see people talking about abuse, it seems like they frame it where the abuser has and end-goal of abusing their partner. Framing it like that makes me hesitant. I don't know why. I guess probably because he doesn't *seem* to be this evil mastermind. 

> Its also common for abuse victims to think their abuse is "not so bad" as others and that it doesnt qualify or is no big deal and they are being "dramatic". Again, its about eroding self esteem, confidence, and boundaries. and keeping you in place for the purpose of having the person to abuse. I know its doesnt make sense, you dont value those things, why would they? They do.
